A guarded deadend+free focus chunk was tried before ship and REJECTED on the band (deadend fixed 88% > S4 83, free 81, but the unexercised kinds drifted to a 63.9% mean — the focus-mode signature); the deadend-fix genome is preserved at wf-of2r-de-g523.candidate.json for a future deadend-focus + full-band-release pump. The detour kinds stay parked for the fitness-shaping revisit.
